purpose: Integrate the frozen R7 qualitative analyzer at the source boundary so unsupported qualitative requirements are rejected before LLM/CIR generation and supported qualitative requirements can repair unresolved source requirements without inventing numeric values.

required_order: LLM CIR generation only if source accepted
architecture.r7_position: after existing source analysis but before call_cir
architecture.reason: Unsupported qualitative source semantics must be contained before probabilistic CIR generation.

supported_behavior.principle: R7 may repair only an existing unresolved source requirement when the source text is recognized by the frozen R7 supported qualitative mapping.

unsupported_behavior.principle: Any non-negated R7 unsupported qualitative match fails closed before call_cir.

pre_guard_reconciliation.case_3_pre_guard_rejects_only_due_to_unr: remove only the matching unresolved-requirement error and continue if no other source error remains

removal_requires: the unresolved source_text corresponds to the matched R7 source phrase after frozen normalization

duplicate_capability_policy.example: rapid response + minimal communication delay both normalize to latency_ms
duplicate_capability_policy.reason: Multiple qualitative phrases mapping to one capability must not be interpreted as multiple numeric constraints.

required_integration_tests.supported_existing_accept: R7-supported source already accepted by pre-guard continues to call_cir.
required_integration_tests.supported_repair_dev138: DEV-138 pre-guard unresolved reliable communication is repaired and reaches call_cir.
required_integration_tests.unsupported_pre_llm_rejection: R7 unsupported source is rejected with zero call_cir calls.
required_integration_tests.unresolved_no_change: R7-unrecognized source preserves existing pre-guard decision.
required_integration_tests.other_pre_guard_failure_preserved: R7 must not repair an unrelated pre-guard failure.
required_integration_tests.duplicate_capability: Two qualitative phrases mapping to latency_ms retain two evidence matches but one normalized capability.
required_integration_tests.r6_regression: R6 behavior remains unchanged after R7 integration.

methodology.next_after_successful_integration: close and freeze R7, then close/freeze E3-v3 development
